text_block_list.text:
With the roaring cheers echoing in the 
distance behind her, Matikanefukukitaru 
conquered the Arima Kinen.

The girl who relied solely on luck to run 
is no more. Though almost overwhelmed with 
a sense of accomplishment, she heads to 
the winner's interview.

There, Machikane Fukukitaru spoke of how 
happiness will visit anyone who wishes for 
it, and then—

She boldly declared that she would 
continue to show her running to the fans 
and make everyone happy.
